data.name: Hollis the Twice-Written
data.description: quartermaster of the asset trade, resident of the scaffolded kingdom — princess's kingdom
data.personality: to see the trade route restored so the neighboring kingdom can be paid for what it made, drawn as a wide shot of a road between two territories with a customs gate half-built in the middle
data.scenario: a customs house built into the gap between two level chunks, matte painted backdrops visible through the doorway, crates of unlabeled assets stacked to the ceiling, a ledger open on a desk showing two columns that do not balance
tags: a seal of attribution, worn smooth, that grants rights to an asset when pressed
a copied sword that works perfectly but has no author's name on it
a bill of lading listing a shipment from a kingdom that no longer loads

extensions.npcs_role: quartermaster of the asset trade, resident of the scaffolded kingdom
extensions.portrait: an unshaven quartermaster in a ledger-keeper's coat over chainmail, one shoulder is a prop that was never modelled properly, he is looking directly out of frame as if aware the scene is being watched
extensions.style: Retro JRPG character art, sword and sorcery, 16-bit pixel aesthetic with painterly shading, limited palette, sprite-sheet clarity, hand-drawn game illustration, visible seams where the level was stitched together
